data.one_liner: Dart SDK to connect to Parse Server and Parse Platform backend.
data.what_it_does: Provides a client SDK for Dart and Flutter to connect to a Parse Server backend. It allows querying, saving data, handling user sessions, and real-time live queries.
use_when: You are using Parse Server as your application backend
You need to connect a Flutter or Dart app to Parse Platform features
avoid_when: You are using a different backend service like Firebase or Supabase
You want a pure REST client without the Parse SDK abstractions
strengths: Full access to Parse Server features from Dart/Flutter
Supports live queries and local storage via Sembast
Continuously tested with the latest Dart framework releases
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the Parse Platform ecosystem
May require managing version compatibility with Parse Server versions
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and initialize the SDK in your code.

alternatives.name: supabase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose Supabase if you prefer an open-source Firebase alternative based on PostgreSQL rather than Parse Server.
